findings.title: prepare_host now creates six empty cache groups and reuses zero compiled bytes
findings.evidence: prepare_home creates native-home and exactly the six CACHE_DIRECTORIES (inductor, triton, vllm, cuda, .cache, .tensorrt_llm), records cache_reused_bytes=0 and no relocated compiled artifacts, and performs no archive copy or generated-source rewrite. Three new CPU tests verify all six start empty, prior generated absolute-path files are not imported or modified, and an existing native-home is never overwritten. 98 tests pass in reviews/full-r1-canonical4/cpu-tests.log; the manifest records cpu_tests=98 and repository inputs reviews/full-r1-canonical4/cpu-tests.log and shell-syntax.json. The actual C3 outcome and first-permission-error show the old failure was a copied TorchInductor generated file embedding /experiment/native-home; the new empty cache removes that reuse path.
findings.impact: The observed C3 first-warmup PermissionError from a stale copied absolute path is closed in the affected source. Compilation/autotuning now occurs in the untimed G1 initialization only; no old cache is reused.
findings.minimal_fix: None for source; use fresh empty caches in G1.

findings.title: Fresh compile/autotune may exceed the unchanged service budget; it must fail honestly
findings.evidence: The service budget remains 3420s with the 25s TERM/KILL reserve and 3300s bootstrap alarm; cache remains 600s; no extension or coverage reduction was added. With zero cache reuse, first warmup compile/autotune is now inside the same untimed G1 window. If it exceeds the alarm, bootstrap/supervisor fail closed; the code does not extend the budget or skip 32-rank/business/60s coverage.
findings.impact: The compile cost is unmeasured and G1 may honestly fail on the fixed budget. This is not a static source defect and does not require an unguarded pre-approval compile run. Formal timing remains separate and must freeze warm JIT caches under its own R2/v11 guard.
findings.minimal_fix: Run G1 with the unchanged budget; on overflow fail and retain the failure. Do not extend or delete coverage; freeze warm JIT caches only for separately reviewed formal timing/R2.
